facts.summary_en: The Canton Tax Office issues a final tax bill for state and municipal taxes of CHF 2,486.40 for the year 2025, due by 30 November 2026.

key_dates.what: Payment due date for the tax bill
Deadline to file a written objection against the tax assessment

actions: Pay CHF 2,486.40 by 30 November 2026 using the attached QR payment slip.
File a written objection against the tax assessment by 12 November 2026 if you wish to contest it.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This letter is a final tax bill from the Canton Tax Office (Kantonales Steueramt). It tells you how much tax you owe for the year 2025.

## What do I need to do?
You have two main options:
1. Pay the bill: You must pay CHF 2,486.40 by **30.11.2026**. Use the QR payment slip that came with the letter.
2. Disagree with the bill: If you think the amount is wrong, you can file a written objection (Einsprache) by **12.11.2026**. You must explain why you disagree.

## Important dates
- **30.11.2026**: The money must be paid by this day.
- **12.11.2026**: The last day to send your objection if you want to contest the bill.

## Money
You owe **CHF 2,486.40** for state and municipal taxes for the year 2025.

## If I disagree or need help
If you disagree with the bill, you must write a letter explaining your reasons and send it by 12.11.2026.

If you are unsure about anything or need help, you can:
- Ask the Canton Tax Office for more information.
- Seek free advice from a local legal aid office or consumer advice centre. They can help you understand your rights and obligations.

facts.summary_en: A parking violation notice issued by the Musterstadt City Police for parking in a prohibited area on 28.09.2026, resulting in a CHF 120 fine to be paid by 31.10.2026.
actions: Pay the CHF 120 fine by 31.10.2026 to avoid additional costs and a formal criminal procedure.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This is a fine notice from the Musterstadt City Police. They say your car was parked in a no-parking zone on 28.09.2026. You must pay a penalty.

## What do I need to do?
You must pay the CHF 120 fine. The deadline is 31.10.2026. Pay by this date to avoid extra costs and a formal criminal procedure (Einsprache).

## Important dates
- 28.09.2026: The parking violation happened.
- 31.10.2026: The last day to pay the fine.

## Money
You owe CHF 120.00. Pay this amount by 31.10.2026.

## If I disagree or need help
If you think the fine is wrong, you can file an objection (Einsprache). However, this letter says a criminal procedure will start if you do not pay on time. For help with this, consider free local legal advice or a consumer advice centre. They can explain your options without cost.

facts.summary_en: The residence permit B of Mr. Bereket Muster expires on 15.01.2027 and he must submit required documents by 01.12.2026 to avoid negative consequences.

key_dates.what: Deadline to submit documents for permit extension

actions: Submit the completed application form, a copy of your valid passport, and a copy of your current employment contract to the Migrationsamt by 01.12.2026.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This letter is from the Migration Office (Migrationsamt) of your canton. They are telling you that your residence permit (Aufenthaltsbewilligung B) will expire on 15.01.2027. You must send them some documents to keep your permit valid.

## What do I need to do?
You must send the following documents to the Migration Office by **01.12.2026**:
- The filled-in application form (it is attached to this letter)
- A copy of your valid passport
- A copy of your current employment contract

## Important dates
- **Deadline to send documents:** 01.12.2026
Do not send them later than this date.

## Money
You will have to pay **CHF 95.00** for the permit extension. They will send you an invoice after they receive your documents.

## If I disagree or need help
If you do not understand this letter or cannot send the documents on time, you should seek free help. Look for local advice centres or community groups that help with immigration issues. They can explain things in your language. If you miss the deadline, your right to stay could be affected, so getting help quickly is important.

facts.summary_en: Health insurance provider sends a reminder for an outstanding premium of CHF 387.20 for September 2026, demanding payment by 20.10.2026 to avoid additional fees and legal action.

amounts.what: Outstanding health insurance premium for September 2026

actions: Pay the outstanding amount of CHF 387.20 by 20.10.2026 to avoid a CHF 30.00 late fee and legal proceedings.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This letter is a reminder from your health insurance company, Gesundheitskasse Muster AG. They are asking you to pay an outstanding health insurance premium.

## What do I need to do?
You must pay the amount of CHF 387.20 by the deadline of 20.10.2026. If you do not pay by this date, they will charge you an extra CHF 30.00 late fee and start legal action (Betreibung).

## Important dates
- Deadline to pay: 20.10.2026

## Money
- Amount owed: CHF 387.20 (for September 2026)
- Extra fee if late: CHF 30.00

## If I disagree or need help
If you think the bill is wrong or you cannot pay, contact Gesundheitskasse Muster AG before the deadline. If you are unsure or need help, seek free advice from a local counselling service. Do not ignore this letter as it may lead to debt collection.

facts.summary_en: A payment order has been issued for CHF 1,150.00 plus interest and CHF 73.30 in costs, totaling CHF 1,223.30, for an outstanding invoice for electrical installation work.
actions: Pay the total amount of CHF 1,223.30 to the creditor within 20 days of receiving this notice.
If you dispute the debt, file an objection in writing or orally with the Betreibungsamt within 10 days of receiving this notice.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This letter is an official notice from the debt collection office (Betreibungsamt). It tells you that someone (the creditor) claims you owe them money.

## What do I need to do?
You have two main options:
1. Pay the full amount of CHF 1,223.30 within 20 days of receiving this letter.
2. If you disagree with the debt, you must tell the debt collection office in writing or in person within 10 days.

## Important dates
- You have **20 days** to pay the money.
- You have **10 days** to object if you think the debt is wrong.

## Money
You owe a total of **CHF 1,223.30**.
- CHF 1,150.00 is the main debt for electrical installation work.
- CHF 73.30 is the cost for this payment order.

## If I disagree or need help
This is a serious matter involving money. If you are unsure about the debt or cannot pay, please seek free advice from a local legal aid office or consumer protection agency. They can help you understand your rights without cost.

## Що мені потрібно зробити?
1. Ви маєте сплатити загальну суму CHF 1'223.30 протягом 20 днів з моменту отримання цього листа.
2. Якщо ви не згодні з боргом або частиною його, ви маєте подати заперечення (Rechtsvorschlag) письмово або усно до того ж органу протягом 10 днів з моменту отримання листа.

## Важливі дати
У листі немає конкретної дати отримання. Важливо знати дату, коли ви отримали цей лист. Від цієї дати починається відлік 20 днів для сплати та 10 днів для заперечення.

Вам потрібно сплатити:
- Основний борг: CHF 1'150.00
- Витрати на лист: CHF 73.30
- Загальна сума: CHF 1'223.30

## Якщо я не згоден або потребую допомоги
Це серйозна справа (стосується грошей). Якщо ви не згодні з боргом, обов'язково подайте заперечення протягом 10 днів. Якщо ви не розумієте, що робити, зверніться за безкоштовною допомогою до місцевих громадських організацій або юристів. Не ігноруйте цей лист.

facts.summary_en: The landlord notifies a rent increase for an apartment from CHF 1,640 to CHF 1,715 per month starting January 1, 2027, citing a rise in the reference mortgage rate.
actions: Contest the rent increase within 30 days of receiving this letter by filing a complaint with the local rent and tenancy conciliation commission if you believe it is abusive.

## What is this letter?
This letter is from your landlord, Régie Immobilière Modèle SA. They are telling you that your rent will go up.

## What do I need to do?
Your rent will increase from CHF 1,640 to CHF 1,715 per month starting on 01.01.2027. If you think this increase is too high or unfair, you can file a complaint. You must do this within 30 days of receiving this letter.

## Important dates
The new rent amount becomes effective on: 01.01.2027
You have 30 days from when you get this letter to file a complaint.

## Money
Your current rent: CHF 1,640.00 per month
Your new rent: CHF 1,715.00 per month

If you disagree with the rent increase, you can contest it. You must contact the local rent and tenancy conciliation commission within 30 days.

facts.summary_en: The Istituto delle assicurazioni sociali requests missing documents to process the 2027 health insurance premium reduction application.

key_dates.what: Deadline to submit missing documents (taxation decision 2025 and 2027 health insurance policy)

actions: Submit a copy of the 2025 tax assessment and the 2027 health insurance policy by 15 November 2026 to avoid the application being considered withdrawn.

English.text:
## What is this letter?
This letter is from the Istituto delle assicurazioni sociali (a social insurance institute). They are asking for missing papers to look at your request for a lower health insurance premium for the year 2027.

## What do I need to do?
You must send two documents by a specific date:
- A copy of your 2025 tax assessment.
- A copy of your health insurance policy for 2027.

You need to send these documents by **15.11.2026**.

## Important dates
- **Deadline: 15.11.2026** (DD.MM.YYYY: 15.11.2026)
If you do not send the documents by this date, your application will be cancelled.

## Money
There are no money amounts to pay or refund in this letter.

## If I disagree or need help
If you cannot find the documents or have questions, you can ask the sender for help. For important matters like this, you can also seek free advice from a local counselling service.
